blurb: Guests can experience a range of services such as bodywork/massage therapy, salt scrubs, mud wraps, reiki, lymphatic drainage, halotherapy (salt therapy), and holistic facial treatments. The Salt Room provides a relaxing environment to breathe in healing salt minerals. The studio emphasizes relaxation, nourishment, and holistic care for body, mind, and spirit.
